title: A sheaf mapping representably with effective descent to an algebraic space is an algebraic space
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file spaces.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for a transformation G -> F of presheaves on (Sch/S)_{fppf} with G a sheaf, F an algebraic space, and a surjective etale U -> F whose fibre product V = G x_F U is representable with V -> U of a property P that is base-change stable, fppf local on the base and effective for fppf descent, the sheaf G is an algebraic space and G -> F is representable with property P (source lines 2004-2023). The proof pulls the covering back along an arbitrary T -> F, exhibits the resulting W as a descent datum for W/(U x_F T)/T by an explicit transition isomorphism, uses effectiveness of P to represent G x_F T, and then concludes with the two same-chapter recognition lemmas.
